turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste, main aapki madad ke liye call kiya hu, kya main aapse kuch puch sakta hu?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Ji bilkul, maine loan foreclosure karwana tha lekin ab mujhe lag raha hai ki NirSahay aur KhedKharcha dono ka calculation thoda confusing lag raha hai.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Chinta mat kariye, hum check karke bata denge ki branch code Active ya refund Lite mein se konsa zyada sahi rahega, aur aapko ZepSetu se bhi verify karwa lena chahiye.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Haan theek hai, bas ye dekhna hai ki Niyo Easy se mera balance match ho raha hai ya nahi aur nominee Select ka bhi confirmation chahiye.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Bilkul, hum sab check kar ke aapko Slice Elite par update bhej denge taaki foreclosure process smoothly complete ho jaaye.
